displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that a carefully specified theistic idealism can merit comparative consideration when consciousness, normativity, and cosmic intelligibility are treated as jointly evidential rather than as independent deductions.

novelty.explanation: This narrows the transcript's categorical claims into a cumulative comparative thesis and makes its dependence on multiple evidential bridges explicit.

premises.text: First-person phenomenal character is not presently derived from structural or functional descriptions alone, so a worldview taking mentality as basic retains a genuine explanatory opportunity without thereby disproving physicalism.

novelty.explanation: This preserves the explanatory-gap argument while repairing its movement from an unresolved explanation to categorical metaphysical impossibility.

premises.text: A mental foundation should count as unifying only if it yields independent constraints across consciousness, moral reasons, and physical regularity rather than merely attaching one label to heterogeneous phenomena.

novelty.explanation: This adds the predictive-constraint requirement missing from the original appeal to one entity and broad explanatory scope.

premises.text: Objective interpersonal obligations would favor a personal ground only if their authority cannot be explained by impersonal normative facts and if their personal character is ontological rather than merely phenomenological.

novelty.explanation: This explicitly addresses the impersonal-realist alternative and separates moral experience from the metaphysical conclusion drawn from it.

premises.text: Any naturalistic origin model requires positive generative structure, and its dispositions, transition principles, and probability measure should be included symmetrically when comparing its simplicity with a divine foundation.

novelty.explanation: This extends the causal-gap objection into a symmetrical complexity comparison rather than treating the exposed lawless formulation as exhaustive.

conclusion.text: Therefore, theistic idealism gains comparative support only insofar as a constrained mental foundation explains phenomenal character, normativity, and lawful order jointly with fewer unsupported commitments than fully specified naturalistic rivals.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately integrates the repaired arguments without claiming that compatibility, explanatory gaps, or unification alone establish theism.

newArguments.title: Cross-domain predictive coherence
newArguments.text: A stronger idealist case would require advance constraints connecting domains: for example, why embodied agents should exhibit stable public neural correlates, why rational inquiry should track mathematically regular structures, and why interpersonal reasons should be discoverable yet imperfectly apprehended. If a single mental-foundation model generated those expectations before accommodating the observations, its unification would acquire evidential content. The argument would then rest on comparative predictive coherence, not merely on calling several unexplained phenomena mental.

novelty.explanation: This is a genuinely new proposal for testing unification through cross-domain advance constraints rather than counting phenomena under one explanatory label.

newArguments.title: Symmetrical foundational accounting
newArguments.text: Compare foundations by listing every primitive commitment on both sides. The naturalistic entry must include its state space, stochastic dispositions, measure, and transition structure; the idealist entry must include the character, capacities, intentions, and lawful relation of the fundamental mind to appearances. Neither partlessness nor a short verbal description automatically establishes simplicity. This symmetry turns the successful causal-gap criticism into a constructive research program and prevents either worldview from hiding specification inside an undefined primitive.

novelty.explanation: This develops two transcript replies into a common accounting method that exposes hidden complexity on both sides.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that naturalism receives comparative support when embodied consciousness, convergent physical structure, and gradual moral development are more expected under independently specified natural mechanisms than under theistic alternatives.

novelty.explanation: This retains the total-evidence strategy while removing unsupported claims of logical entailment, infinite improbability, and decisive simplicity.

premises.text: Systematic manipulation, impairment, and evolutionary variation of brains provide strong evidence that human consciousness depends causally on organized physical systems, even if phenomenal character remains incompletely explained.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the embodiment argument while conceding the explanatory gap instead of treating functional dependence as a complete theory of qualia.

premises.text: Network resemblance supports mentality only after ordinary convergence mechanisms are excluded; thermodynamic, transport, and optimization constraints provide independently motivated competitors that can be tested quantitatively.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the underdeveloped thermodynamic reply by requiring measurable predictions rather than a broad appeal to physical efficiency.

premises.text: Slow, geographically uneven, and error-prone moral development is naturally expected from cultural learning and institutional evolution, whereas many interventionist theisms require auxiliary explanations for that historical pattern.

novelty.explanation: This develops the historical likelihood argument while limiting its target to theisms that independently predict conspicuous moral instruction or intervention.

premises.text: A viable naturalistic foundation must contain positive stochastic or dynamical structure, so its simplicity must be evaluated after specifying a state space, measure, dispositions, and observer-selection conditions.

novelty.explanation: This directly repairs the lawlessness-to-equiprobability inference by accepting the positive structures demanded by the opposing causal-gap objection.

conclusion.text: Therefore, naturalism is comparatively favored only if its fully specified mechanisms jointly predict the observed dependence, structural convergence, and historical development better than correspondingly specified theistic models after symmetrical complexity accounting.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion preserves the comparative naturalistic case while making its strength conditional on explicit models and symmetrical evidential assessment.

newArguments.title: Intervention-profile comparison
newArguments.text: Rather than asking vaguely what God or naturalism could permit, compare intervention profiles. A naturalistic model predicts that cognitive capacities, moral knowledge, and survival prospects should vary with biological and cultural mechanisms. A specified interventionist theism may predict detectable discontinuities, unusually uniform revelation, or protection of crucial moral knowledge. The observed mixture of dependence, fragmentation, and gradual correction can then be evaluated against explicit alternatives. This method reduces speculative claims about divine preferences by tying them to independently stated theological commitments.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a new comparative method based on explicit intervention profiles rather than generic assertions about what either worldview permits.

newArguments.title: Mechanism-first parsimony
newArguments.text: Parsimony should be assessed only after explanatory machinery is displayed. A stochastic cosmology is not simple merely because it begins with a bubble, and a divine theory is not complex merely because its mind knows many truths. Compare description length, adjustable parameters, independent constraints, and predictive concentration for complete models. Naturalism gains an advantage when mechanisms already supported in nearby domains extend successfully with limited additions. This approach preserves Carrier's appeal to causal precedent while abandoning unsupported infinity counting and undefined random selection.

novelty.explanation: This replaces the transcript's unsupported complexity claims with a more disciplined and symmetrical parsimony framework.
